Counts: accepted 12, adapted 8, rejected 0, deferred 0. All blocker and major issues are covered, so done: true.
decision.rationale: I applied the decision guide's authority order. Correctness fixes come first: the a11y letter count and ARIA name vs role. Next come the copydeck rules: junior sentences of at most 12 words and cards of at most 3 sentences, no giveaways, hints that do not echo the answer, no brand names, and 2-sentence explanations. Several persona suggestions would have broken those limits, so I adapted them. Two of them also hit the validator rule that a lesson with a limit card needs a limit question, which is why l02-q4 stays type 'limit'. Every fix stays inside the one owned file, and no ids or answers change. I made no file edits, so the verdict table is included in the instructions; no spec file was assigned to write it into.
applicationNotes: Replaced the blindfold-style prompt with a companion reading the packaging without showing the image, keeping the focus on what a description conveys.
Kept 44–48 px as a recommendation and explained the WCAG 2.2 AA default of 24 × 24 CSS pixels with exceptions.
Used keyboard-only testing in the park analogy limit without implying that physical accessibility can be judged by sight alone.
Balanced choice length cues and synchronized the Junior tagline from the existing world metadata.
decision.verification: node --import tsx scripts/validate-content.ts --world=a10 passed with zero findings for a10.

judgeIssues.problem: Meaning error. The junior text reads "Singkatannya a11y, karena ada 11 huruf di antara a dan y." right after the word "Aksesibilitas". The English word 'accessibility' appears only in the Pro text. A child who counts the letters of 'aksesibilitas' finds it ends in 's', not 'y', so the explanation does not work.
judgeIssues.suggestion: Junior: "Dalam bahasa Inggris, kata ini ditulis accessibility. Ada 11 huruf di antara a dan y, jadi disingkat a11y." Or remove a11y from junior entirely.

judgeIssues.problem: Tests something junior never learned. "Gambar hiasan sebaiknya tidak dibacakan oleh alat pembaca layar." In l03 the alt text and decorative-image card is Pro-only (modes: ['pro']), and no junior card explains what a 'pembaca layar' is.
judgeIssues.suggestion: Make r2 Pro-only, or add a junior concept line: 'Ada alat yang membacakan isi layar dengan suara untuk orang yang tidak bisa melihat. Gambar hiasan cukup dilewati.'

judgeIssues.problem: The words 'alat bantu' and 'pembaca layar' are never explained in junior mode: "Alat bantu, misalnya pembaca layar" and "Jalur itu beton. Web harus cocok dengan alat bantu." The 'beton' sentence also does not explain why web is different.
judgeIssues.suggestion: Add one junior sentence in l01: 'Ada orang yang memakai alat yang membacakan layar dengan suara.' Change the limit text to 'Jalur miring cukup dilewati. Web juga harus bisa dipakai dengan keyboard dan alat pembaca suara.'

judgeIssues.where: a10-l02 conceptStep 'ARIA dan aturan pertamanya' + a10-anc-p4 explainCorrect
judgeIssues.problem: Factual muddle. The card says "ARIA adalah atribut tambahan yang memberi tahu pembaca layar peran sebuah elemen", but the example, aria-label="Tutup", gives a name, not a role. a10-anc-p4 repeats the mistake: "menambal elemen yang belum cukup menjelaskan peran, seperti tombol ikon ×". A <button> already has its role; what it lacks is a name.
judgeIssues.suggestion: 'ARIA memberi tahu pembaca layar nama, peran, atau keadaan elemen yang belum jelas dari HTML. Tombol ikon × sudah berperan tombol, tetapi belum punya nama, jadi diberi aria-label="Tutup".'

judgeIssues.problem: The answer is given away. The prompt starts "Selain kursi roda, siapa lagi..." and then offers "Hanya orang yang memakai kursi roda" as a choice, which the prompt itself rules out. Only two real choices remain.
judgeIssues.suggestion: Replace that distractor with something believable, such as 'Orang yang naik sepeda motor', with explainWrong 'Motor lewat jalan raya, bukan trotoar.'

judgeIssues.problem: "Alat otomatis hanya menangkap sebagian masalah. Kamu tetap perlu mencoba sendiri." Junior mode never mentions any automatic tool, so Naya has nothing to connect 'alat otomatis' to.
judgeIssues.suggestion: Junior: 'Taman dicek dengan mata. Web juga perlu dicoba sendiri, misalnya tanpa mouse.'

judgeIssues.problem: Giveaway. The prompt asks about "mencoba web hanya dengan keyboard", and only the correct choice, "Lepas mouse, lalu tekan Tab untuk berpindah", mentions mouse, keyboard or Tab. Raka can match keywords without thinking.
judgeIssues.suggestion: Use distractors that also involve the keyboard, e.g. 'Tekan Caps Lock berkali-kali' or 'Ketik namamu di kolom isian'.

judgeIssues.problem: The hint and the explanation sort by different rules. The hint says "apakah hambatan itu berasal dari tubuh atau dari lingkungan?", which separates only situational from the rest; permanent and temporary both come from the body. The explanation says "Hambatan dibedakan dari lamanya".
judgeIssues.suggestion: Use one two-step rule in both: 'Dari tubuh atau lingkungan? Kalau dari tubuh: akan pulih atau tidak?'

judgeIssues.where: a10-l03-q2 (junior item b1) + a10-l03 keyboard concept
judgeIssues.problem: "Menghapus garis penanda tombol tanpa pengganti": the junior concept never explains what a focus 'garis penanda' is (it appears only in the alt text), and 'tanpa pengganti' is abstract for an 8-year-old.
judgeIssues.suggestion: Add to the junior concept: 'Saat menekan Tab, tombol yang dipilih diberi garis. Garis itu jangan dihapus.' Shorten b1 to 'Menghapus garis tanda tombol yang dipilih'.

judgeIssues.problem: "Mengurangi gerakan saat diminta": it is unclear who asks or how. The idea of a setting that asks for less motion is never introduced in junior mode.
judgeIssues.suggestion: 'Membuat kartu berhenti berputar kalau Bito pusing' or 'Menyediakan tombol untuk menghentikan gerakan'.

judgeIssues.problem: The prompt asks "Pengaturan CSS apa yang sebaiknya dihormati" but the choices are actions ("Mengurangi animasi saat reduced motion aktif"), not settings. The distractor "Mengunci ukuran huruf" has nothing to do with motion.
judgeIssues.suggestion: Prompt: 'Apa yang sebaiknya dilakukan halaman untuk membantu Bito?' Or make the choices settings: prefers-reduced-motion / prefers-color-scheme / font-size: 2rem.

judgeIssues.problem: The word 'fitur aksesibilitas' is too hard for Naya, and the explanation does not say why: "Fitur itu menolong saat itu." It never names which feature.
judgeIssues.suggestion: Prompt: 'Web yang ramah bisa menolong siapa saja.' Explanation: 'Tulisan besar dan tulisan ucapan video menolong saat layar silau atau tempat berisik.'

judgeIssues.problem: Small meaning slip: "Aksesibilitas artinya halaman web yang bisa dipakai semua orang" defines the word as a page rather than a quality.
judgeIssues.suggestion: 'Aksesibilitas artinya web bisa dipakai semua orang.'

judgeIssues.problem: WCAG is introduced only as "Pedoman web bernama WCAG" with no full name and no hint of how it is used at work. Sari will see the acronym in job posts and audit reports.
judgeIssues.suggestion: Add '(Web Content Accessibility Guidelines), standar yang sering diminta klien dan dipakai sebagai acuan hukum di banyak negara.'

judgeIssues.problem: The 'correct' line <button aria-label="Cari">Cari</button> uses aria-label that only repeats the visible text. That is the ARIA overuse the lesson itself warns against ("Pakai seperlunya").
judgeIssues.suggestion: Use <button>Cari</button> without aria-label, or make line 3 an icon button that actually needs aria-label.

judgeIssues.problem: Labelled type 'analogy' / 'limit' with analogy 'Fasilitas taman umum yang ramah', but neither question is about an analogy or its limits. If the UI shows an analogy label, the learner will be confused.
judgeIssues.suggestion: Change both types to standard mcq/scenario and remove the analogy field from q4.

judgeIssues.problem: "Jaga target sentuh 44–48 px" sits next to the WCAG AA target, which implies AA requires it. It does not: AA (2.5.8) requires 24 px; 44 px is AAA or a platform guideline.
judgeIssues.suggestion: Add 'rekomendasi Apple/Google; WCAG AA minimal 24 px'.

judgeIssues.problem: "supaya tidak ada orang yang tertinggal di belakang pintu tertutup" is flowery and slightly preachy, and the sentence is long.
judgeIssues.suggestion: Cut it to: 'Sebelum rilis, tim menjalankan daftar periksa aksesibilitas, seperti petugas mengecek taman sebelum dibuka.'

judgeIssues.problem: The explanation covers the cast, eyes and glare, but not item c4 "Satu tangan memegang tas belanja", the trickiest case for a child, so it does not say why it counts as 'Karena situasi'.
judgeIssues.suggestion: Add: 'Tas belanja bisa ditaruh, jadi kesulitannya karena situasi.'

judgeIssues.problem: "Minta kakak menjelaskan..." assumes the child has an older sibling. It is also not clear whose eyes are closed.
judgeIssues.suggestion: 'Tutup matamu 1 menit. Minta orang di rumah menjelaskan isi kemasan makanan.'
